passages.title: Forest conservation — supplied practice example
passages.text: Forests play a vital role in sustaining ecological balance and maintaining atmospheric equilibrium. They act as natural carbon sinks, absorbing millions of tons of greenhouse gases annually while replenishing vital oxygen reserves. In recent decades, urban expansion and commercial deforestation have threatened biological diversity and disrupted seasonal monsoon cycles. Preserving natural heritage demands collective action from civic administrations, environmental scientists, and local communities. Sustainable conservation policies encourage community forestry, renewable energy adoption, and stringent penalties for unauthorized resource exploitation. Every citizen shares an active responsibility to protect indigenous wildlife and preserve ecological habitats for future generations.
